findings.claim_text: The second is "removal of all DeepSeek and DeepSeek-affiliate products, and third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek implementations, from civilian agency information technology"[^1].
Several words that dominate the coverage do not appear in the notice at all: "derivative," "open-weight," "weights," "model," "hosted," and "cloud"[^1].
The most defensible reading: the order carries a July 24, 2026 release date, and the June 26 reference is either an earlier letter or a misreading.
findings.contradicting_quote: a letter from Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin ordering the exclusion of DeepSeek products on June 26, indicating the ban has been in place for months
